about.what: Inputs written to break the fix-3 rule, never in the corpus. Each round was written after a change to the rule and run before the next change; rounds 1 to 3 then shaped the rule, so only round 4 measured the final rule fresh (before the one regex fix it exposed: 'need' read as a past tense).
